title: Senior Analyst, Applications Programming
description:
**About Analog Devices**
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

* Minimum 8 to 12 years of SAP S/4 HANA development experience
* Candidate should have worked on at least three implementation projects and two support projects
* Candidate must have good hands on experience in RICEF development objects \& also


 Should have good hands on experience using SAP BTP, RAP \& CAPM
   

  

* Must have good knowledge and hands on experience in each of the following areas:


 Data Dictionary
   

  

 Reports \& ALV Programming
   

  

 Dialog (Transaction) Programming
   

  

 Enhancements (User Exits, BADI, BAPI etc.)
   

  

 Interfaces (IDOCS, Remote Function Calls, Web Services etc.)
   

  

* Candidate should have good experience / knowledge in Adobe forms.
* Candidate should have experience in OData model
* HANA Modelling \- Calculation views, Stored procedures, Scalar \& Table functions, Performance tuning techniques
* Extensive experience of SAP Enhancement techniques like EXITS, BADIS and new enhancement framework techniques.
* Good Debugging Skills and Performance Tuning using ABAP Cockpit, SQL Tracer (ST05/ST12\), Runtime Analysis (SE/SAT) and Code Inspector (SCI).
* Should be able to aware on latest concepts and developed objects using latest techniques like Inline coding, RAP \& CAPM
* Candidate should have good experience in developing and consuming HANA views .
* Should have knowledge on developing Fiori application.
* Should possess skills of technical architecting, designing, and delivering complex developments.
* Need to have strong Troubleshooting skills
* Should be able to perform peer code reviews and provide feedback
* Able to understand 3rd party integration approaches with SAP.
* Candidate should be familiar with SAP SD,PP and MM Modules
* Able to work onsite\-offshore team
* Proactive in resolving the issues and taking additional responsibilities.


*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce \- Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State \- Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.
